title: SmimeError::AllSignersFailed creates circular module dependency
description: error.rs imports crate::verify::SignerResult for the AllSignersFailed variant; verify.rs imports crate::SmimeError from error.rs. This circular module dependency is legal in Rust but unusual and creates tight coupling: moving or refactoring SignerResult requires touching error.rs. Scenario: a contributor adds a new field to SignerResult, which compiles fine, but the structural coupling is invisible until a future refactor. Fix: move SignerResult (and VerificationResult) to a separate types.rs or to error.rs itself, breaking the cycle.
